Sent:	Thursday, November 7, 2024 4:57 PM
To:	Burgess, James
Subject:	Revised Investment Agreement

Har,

At long last, attached please find the revised agreement, in redline and in final.  My instructions were to prepare execution copies, have them signed on behalf of the various Atlas Holdings entities, and they are being hand delivered to Mr. Joshua in your Portfolio Ops group for execution on behalf of the various Cedar Point entities.  I also prepared side letter agreements from Atlas Holdings and from Cedar Point, each of which has been either executed or acknowledged on behalf of Atlas Holdings.  The decision upstairs was that this final version was "take it or leave it" for Cedar Point.

A summary of the major changes:

1.   All fee language and references to Capital Calls were removed.
2.   All investment [ORG_6] were included.
3.   The "Fund" payment concept was eliminated in Section 4 because it was not clear who would actually be making the payment.

Thanks.

Oscar

(See attached file: Cedar Point Investment Agreement 11-8.doc)(See attached file: Cedar Point Investment Agreement 11-8 Redline)
